about.title: About us
about.lead: Padova 6 is a scout group of AGESCI, the Italian Catholic Guides and Scouts Association. We support girls and boys aged 8 to 21 at the parish of Cristo Re in Padova.

history.title: Our story
history.y1968: The presumed founding year. The group starts as Padova 2, an offshoot of the San Francesco section in central Padova.
history.y1981: Now called Padova 6, the group is large enough to expand into the nearby parish of Santa Rita, with a second pack and two new troops, one for boys and one for girls. The Rover and Ranger branch stays a single unit.
history.y2002: Fewer leaders and young people lead to closing the Santa Rita units. The group takes its current shape: the Candida Luna Pack, the Enterprise and Orione troops, the Novitiate and the Pioggia Battente Clan.
history.y2022: On 28 December the group is entered in the national Third Sector register (RUNTS) as a social promotion association.

method.title: The scout method
method.intro: Scouting comes from an idea of Baden-Powell: you grow by doing, together with others and outdoors. AGESCI turns that idea into a method.

doing.title: Learning by doing
doing.text: Building, finding your way, cooking at camp, running a project: you learn by getting your hands on it.

outdoors.title: Outdoor life
outdoors.text: Woods, meadows and trails are where we play, hike and spend time together.

groups.title: Small groups
groups.text: Sixes in the Pack, patrols in the Troop: everyone has a place and a responsibility towards the others.

growth.title: Personal growth
growth.text: Everyone follows their own path, with goals chosen together with the leaders and suited to their age.

service.title: Service
service.text: Doing your best for others, from the Cubs’ good turn to the Clan’s volunteering.

faith.title: Faith
faith.text: AGESCI is a Catholic association: faith is part of the journey and is lived in the community and in the parish.

leaders.title: Our leaders
leaders.text: Our leaders are volunteer educators, trained through AGESCI programmes. Each unit has its own leaders, who prepare the activities and follow the growth of every young person.
leaders.community: Together they form the Leaders’ Council, which runs the group and writes its educational plan.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.lead: Why we do scouting and what we believe in: the AGESCI values we live at Padova 6.

purpose.title: Our purpose
purpose.quote: To contribute, following the principle of self-education, to the growth of young people as meaningful and happy persons.
purpose.text: Self-education means that girls and boys lead their own growth: they discover, try and choose, with their leaders beside them. Every activity of the group, from the Pack’s hunt to the Clan’s service, comes from this purpose.

choices.title: The three choices
choices.intro: The Association Pact is the document every AGESCI leader commits to. It rests on three choices.

scout.title: The scout choice
scout.text: “Leaders bear witness to their personal commitment to the Scout Law and Promise.” They offer young people the scout method, where play, adventure and discovery become chances to grow.

christian.title: The Christian choice
christian.text: Leaders welcome the message of Christ and bear witness to it with their own lives. In the group, faith is lived together, in the community and in the parish.

political.title: The political choice
political.text: “The choice of political action is an essential commitment that defines us as citizens”: educating young people to take an active and responsible part in caring for the common good.

law.title: The Scout Law
law.intro: The Law says in simple words how a Guide or a Scout lives. In AGESCI it has ten articles.
law.subject: Guides and Scouts:
law.a1: place their honour in being worthy of trust;
law.a3: make themselves useful and help others;
law.a4: are friends to all and brothers and sisters to every other Guide and Scout;
law.a8: smile and sing even in difficulties;
law.a10: are pure in thought, word and deed.

pack.title: The Law of the Pack
pack.intro: Cubs have their own Law, in two articles:
pack.a1: The Cub thinks of others as of himself.
pack.a2: The Cub lives with joy and loyalty together with the Pack.

promise.title: The Promise
promise.intro: With the Promise, everyone freely chooses to commit to living the Law. Scouts and Guides say it with these words:
promise.opening: With God’s help, I promise on my honour to do my best:
promise.p1: to do my duty to God and to my country;
promise.p2: to help other people at all times;
promise.pack: Cubs have their own words: “I promise, with the help and example of Jesus, to do my best to improve myself, to help others and to keep the Law of the Pack.”

mottos.title: The mottos
mottos.intro: Each branch has its own motto. The motto of the association is “Be prepared”.

bp.quote: Try and leave this world a little better than you found it.
bp.source: Robert Baden-Powell, founder of Scouting, in his last message to Scouts

path.title: The scout journey
path.lead: From Cubs to Rovers and Rangers: how scouting is lived in the five units of Padova 6.

timeline.title: Three stages, from 8 to 21
timeline.intro: The scout journey has three stages. Each has its own unit, leaders and way of experiencing adventure.

pack.title: Cub pack (Branco)
pack.description: Cub scouts discover games, outdoor life and their first responsibilities together.

troop.title: Scout troop (Reparto)
troop.description: Scouts and guides work in patrols, taking on projects, camps and scout skills.

clan.title: Novitiate and Clan
clan.description: Rovers and rangers choose a path of hiking, community and service.

pack.name: Candida Luna Pack
pack.text: The Pack lives its adventure in the world of Rudyard Kipling’s The Jungle Book: children grow through play and learn to do their best together with others.
pack.groups: Black, Brown, Piebald, Tawny, White and Grey.
pack.when: On Sundays and, about once a month, a hunt: a one-day outing.

troops.name: Enterprise and Orione Troops
troops.text: The group has two parallel troops: Enterprise for boys and Orione for girls. In the Troop, life is organised in patrols, small groups led by one of the older members, and everyone learns the scout skills needed for projects and camps.
troops.groups: Enterprise: Cheetahs, Eagles and Wolves. Orione: Swallows, Dolphins and Lions.
troops.when: On Sundays and, about once a month, a bivouac, usually from Saturday afternoon to Sunday afternoon.

novitiate.name: Novitiate
novitiate.who: Ages 16–17 · third year of high school
novitiate.text: A transition year between the Troop and the Clan. It is the time to discover the three words of the Clan: road, community and service.

clan.name: Pioggia Battente Clan
clan.text: The Clan lives scouting through the road, community and service. The journey ends with the Departure: the choice to carry scout values into adult life.
clan.when: A meeting every week, not on Sundays. Plus outings, bivouacs and volunteering.

monthly.what: Pack hunt, Troop bivouac, Clan outings
